honors.title: Unflinching Courage Award
honors.description: Jun Kim has shown unflinching courage in taking on new responsibilities over the last 4 months. Jun has been tasked as serving as a technical guidance leader with the SEMS Development Team. In addition to his normal development tasks, Jun has taken on new responsibilities such has starting the Records Management think-tank sessions, serving as a Job Leader to new developers on the team, serving as a point of contact and expert in UX sessions, leading daily development standup sessions, and serving as the moderator for our sprint retros. Jun is constantly leveraged by other developers with their code, utilizing collaboration to help others meet their full potential and drive holistic goals of the project. Jun has even offered up ‘Office Hour’ sessions for the DEV Team to promotion a synergistic cooperation between team members. Jun is the first to use the collective sum of a team to best facilitate a solution to client needs. Jun keeps an upbeat and positive attitude throughout all client interactions and tasks. Jun is a joy to work with and is a valuable member of the SEMS Team. We are lucky to have him.
